nodes.label: Once-Per-Database Pack Import Rule
nodes.rationale: Each pack is imported once per database under AppMeta key pack:<pack_id> (key truncated to 40 chars, limiting pack_id to <=34 chars); editing an already-live pack has no effect, so additions require a new pack file (optionally borrowing via _foreign_questions) and live fixes require _once() in monday/cleanup.py.

nodes.label: Maintenance Announcement & Progress Preservation Lifecycle
nodes.rationale: Transitions maintenance state off -> scheduled (10-15 min pre-deploy) -> active -> off using additive deploy-safety tables (activity_draft, client_op, maintenance_state, maintenance_log) so in-progress student answers queue safely and resume after redeployment.

nodes.label: Content Packs System
nodes.rationale: Ready-made questions and figures live in monday/data/packs/ and are auto-imported once per database on startup (controllable via IMPORT_PACKS and PUBLISH_PACKS) so fresh local and Render deployments always receive content automatically.

nodes.label: Content Tree (Abilities Map)
nodes.rationale: All questions, homework, tests, and progress attach by permanent ID to a three-level Topic -> Subtopic -> Node hierarchy in content_node with archive-only deletion and teacher-owned branches (owner_id), allowing tree expansion without breaking historical results.

nodes.label: Teacher Invite Codes
nodes.rationale: Per-row invite codes (e.g., MND-4K7Q) and /join/<code> links bind a teacher's manual student roster entry to a registered student account so progress switches automatically from manual estimates to live tracked data.

nodes.label: Skill Mastery & Exam Forecast
nodes.rationale: A skill is considered mastered when the last 5-8 answers achieve at least 80% accuracy; exam score forecasts map skill accuracy onto each exam's score scale defined in EXAMS.

nodes.label: Bundled Self-Hosted Assets & Performance
nodes.rationale: Fonts and KaTeX are bundled in static/fonts and static/vendor/katex with 1-year versioned caching, response compression, hover prefetching, and ~200 KB image shrinking (including HEIC) so the app works reliably without external CDNs.

nodes.label: Question Moderation & Trusted Teacher Threshold
nodes.rationale: Questions authored by new teachers require admin approval until reaching TRUSTED_TEACHER_THRESHOLD (20 approved questions), after which trusted teachers publish directly.

nodes.label: Supabase Postgres & Private Storage Integration
nodes.rationale: Uses Supabase Session pooler because Render cannot reach direct Supabase endpoints, enables RLS on every table to block Supabase web API access, and serves private uploads via auth-checked /uploads/<name> redirects to 2-hour signed URLs.

nodes.label: Flask-Babel Translation Layer
nodes.rationale: Interface strings use Russian as the source language via pybabel gettext catalogs (ky, kk, uz, tg, en), while questions carry an independent language field so teachers can write content in any language.

nodes.label: Immutable Work Versions
nodes.rationale: Publishing a work freezes its questions into an immutable version; subsequent edits publish a new version while preserving existing student results on the prior version.
